subject: pharmacology
title: Cytotoxic Anticancer VII: Etoposide and Irinotecan in Depth

steps.tx: **Etoposide** traps topoisomerase II on DNA after it has cut both strands, so replication forks collide with protein DNA complexes and shatter chromosomes, killing chiefly in late S and G2. Podophyllum resin supplied the parent scaffold; chemical editing turned a spindle poison into a topoisomerase poison, a genealogy worth knowing because teniposide and the parent compound behave differently at the bedside.
steps.say: Etoposide does not cut DNA itself; it handcuffs the enzyme that already cut it.

nodes.label: Topoisomerase II cuts both DNA strands
Replication fork collides and shatters chromosome
Double strand breaks trigger cell death

steps.tx: **Etoposide** does not cut DNA by its own chemistry. It traps topoisomerase II after that enzyme has already cut both strands, so replication forks hit the complex and shatter the chromosome. Cell death is greatest in late S and in G2. Podophyllum resin supplied the scaffold, and chemical editing turned a spindle poison into a topoisomerase poison. Teniposide and the parent compound do not behave the same way at the bedside.
steps.say: Etoposide handcuffs topoisomerase II after the enzyme has already cut both DNA strands. Replication forks hit those frozen complexes and break the chromosome, mainly in late S and G2. The medicine was redesigned from a podophyllum spindle poison. Teniposide and the parent resin are not the same bedside drug.

vis.alt: Topoisomerase II is trapped on DNA after cutting both strands, with the drug holding the cleavage complex in place.
vis.caption: The enzyme has opened both DNA strands and cannot reseal them because etoposide keeps the complex locked. Illustration: StewardMD original.

steps.tx: **Small cell lung cancer** is etoposide's home regimen: etoposide plus cisplatin or carboplatin (EP) for four to six cycles, concurrent with thoracic radiation in limited stage, where its marrow ceiling and platinum's kidney ceiling interlock without overlap. Prophylactic cranial irradiation debates and immunotherapy maintenance now surround the backbone without replacing it.
steps.say: EP is small cell lung cancer's skeleton; radiation and immunotherapy hang on it, not instead of it.

left.title: EP architecture
points: Etoposide days 1 to 3 with platinum day 1
Marrow and kidney ceilings non overlapping

right.title: Around the backbone
points: Second line topotecan or lurbinectedin territory
Growth factor support by febrile risk

steps.tx: **BEP** (bleomycin, etoposide, cisplatin) cures most metastatic germ cell tumours, oncology's proof that cytotoxic combinations can cure solid cancer: three or four cycles by prognostic group, bleomycin lung monitoring and cisplatin kidney ear protection from earlier lessons converging, with tumour markers (AFP, hCG, LDH) falling as the response assay. Etoposide substitution (VIP regimens) answers bleomycin lung failure.
steps.say: BEP cures testicular cancer; markers falling are the chemotherapy working in numbers.

left.title: BEP components
points: Cisplatin five days with forced diuresis
Three versus four cycles by IGCCCG risk

right.title: Response assays
points: AFP and hCG half lives tracked
Residual masses resected or watched by histology rules
Survivorship: fertility, lung, kidney, second malignancy

steps.tx: **Oral etoposide** trades peak for persistence: daily low doses in relapsed ovarian, small cell and palliative settings exploit schedule dependence, billing prolonged marrow suppression and mucositis at cumulative exposures intravenous courses avoid. Capsule adherence, food effects and renal dose cuts (etoposide clears renally, halve at low clearances) make it a considered rather than gentle option.
steps.say: Oral etoposide is schedule pharmacology in a capsule, not a softer drug.

left.title: Oral niches
points: Relapsed small cell and ovarian palliation

steps.tx: **Secondary leukaemia** after etoposide differs from alkylator leukaemia in tempo and genetics: balanced translocations at 11q23 (MLL) and 21q22, latency typically two to three years, often without a myelodysplastic prelude, dose and schedule related. Survivorship consent states it plainly alongside infertility, and cumulative etoposide dose is recorded with the same permanence as anthracycline dose.
steps.say: Etoposide leukaemia arrives in two to three years with 11q23; alkylator leukaemia takes longer by a different road.

left.title: Topo II leukaemia
points: Latency 2 to 3 years, no MDS prelude usually
Weekly and twice weekly schedules implicated

right.title: Alkylator leukaemia contrast
points: Latency 5 to 7 years with dysplastic phase

steps.tx: **Irinotecan** activation runs carboxylesterases to SN 38 (a thousand fold more potent), then UGT1A1 glucuronidation to inactive SN 38G excreted in bile, where bacterial beta glucuronidases reactivate it in the gut and author late diarrhoea. Antibiotics, loperamide timing and UGT genetics all act on this enterohepatic loop, making irinotecan the metabolism lesson with a chemotherapy badge.
steps.say: Gut bacteria resurrect SN 38 from bile; late diarrhoea is metabolism completing a circle.

nodes.label: UGT1A1 glucuronidates to SN-38G in bile
Bacterial enzymes reactivate in gut: late diarrhoea

steps.tx: **Topotecan** irinotecan's sibling, bills marrow almost alone (neutropenia and thrombocytopenia on daily times five schedules) in relapsed ovarian and small cell disease, while liposomal irinotecan extends pancreatic cancer survival after gemcitabine in NAPOLI regimens. Same topoisomerase, three personalities written by formulation and schedule, the recurring cytotoxic moral.
steps.say: One enzyme target, three drugs; formulation and schedule write the personality.

left.title: Topotecan
points: Relapsed ovarian and small cell lung

right.title: Liposomal irinotecan
points: Not interchangeable mg for mg with conventional

steps.tx: **Infusion safety** give etoposide its administration rules: dilute adequately, infuse over at least 30 to 60 minutes (rapid pushes drop blood pressure), watch first doses, and respect solvent and filter instructions, while irinotecan's early cholinergic syndrome (cramps, sweating, diarrhoea during infusion) answers atropine and premedication on later cycles. Chair side pharmacology again, protocolised because it recurs.
steps.say: Slow the etoposide, atropinise the irinotecan gut; infusion speed is a drug property.

right.title: Irinotecan administration
points: Loperamide dispensed with teaching at discharge
Dose by UGT1A1 and bilirubin fences
